tests.name: iter_dereference_object
tests.intent: Probes the dereference operator on an object iterator to verify value access correctness after reordering.

tests.name: iter_dereference_array
tests.intent: Probes the dereference operator on an array iterator to verify fallback correctness after checking objects first.

tests.name: iter_arrow_object
tests.intent: Probes the arrow operator on an object iterator.

tests.name: iter_arrow_array
tests.intent: Probes the arrow operator or equivalent pointer retrieval on an array iterator.

tests.name: iter_increment_object
tests.intent: Probes prefix increment operator on an object iterator.

tests.name: iter_increment_array
tests.intent: Probes prefix increment operator on an array iterator.

tests.name: iter_decrement_object
tests.intent: Probes prefix decrement operator on an object iterator.

tests.name: iter_decrement_array
tests.intent: Probes prefix decrement operator on an array iterator.

tests.name: iter_equality_object
tests.intent: Probes equality comparison between object iterators.

tests.name: iter_equality_array
tests.intent: Probes equality comparison between array iterators.

tests.name: iter_ordered_json_object
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json object iteration behavior with the reordered branches.

tests.name: iter_const_object
tests.intent: Probes const iterator dereference and traversal on an object.

tests.name: iter_const_array
tests.intent: Probes const iterator dereference and traversal on an array.

tests.name: iter_empty_object
tests.intent: Probes begin and end equality on an empty object.

tests.name: iter_empty_array
tests.intent: Probes begin and end equality on an empty array.

tests.name: iter_primitive_fallback
tests.intent: Probes iterator behavior on a primitive value to verify non-object/non-array fallback.

tests.name: iter_nested_containers
tests.intent: Probes iteration over an object containing arrays to test mixed branch traversal.

tests.name: iter_post_increment
tests.intent: Probes postfix increment operator on an object iterator.

tests.name: iter_post_decrement
tests.intent: Probes postfix decrement operator on an object iterator.

tests.name: iter_inequality
tests.intent: Probes inequality operator between iterators.
